prompt: Design a premium social-media advertisement for ZipPilot, a shared neighborhood direct-mail service. Brand style: deep navy blue background (#0A1E3C), bright blue (#2F80ED) and vivid green (#5BC236) accents, clean modern sans-serif typography, high contrast, professional advertising quality. Include the provided ZipPilot logo mark (blue location pin with a house and green growth arrow) at the top with the wordmark 'ZipPilot' shown with 'Zip' in white and 'Pilot' in bright blue. All text must be spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible.  Layout: stylized dark navy city map with a glowing street grid seen from above; one ZIP-code territory outlined in a bright green glow with a large ZipPilot location pin planted in its center like a flag; neighboring territories dimmed. Headline in huge bold white capitals: 'OWN YOUR ZIP CODE.' Sub lines: 'Market Leader double slot — $999/mo' in bright blue and 'Add more ZIP codes at 50% off' in vivid green. Bottom: green pill button 'Claim Your Territory' and URL 'TheZipPilot.com' in white.
